Current stage
+

Gen-Z is in pre-pilot development. This experience demonstrates a product concept and does not accept real investment funds. An anchor asset and final offering terms have not been announced.

Project rights and risk
+

Project rights depend on final issuer documents. They do not automatically represent direct ownership of a physical asset. Returns and principal repayment are not guaranteed; losses or delays are possible.
